prompt: CSS color() function non-legacy sRGB minimum precision requirement
answer: The minimum precision for non-legacy `color(srgb ...)` is **10 bits per component** for round-tripping. Values must be rounded toward **+∞**, not truncated. ([CSS Color 4](https://zh.luxuryportfolio.com/wg-cgi/www.w3.org/TR/2024/CRD-css-color-4-20240213/#11))
